meta.label: Fitness equipment
meta.attribution: Covers dumbbells for a home in the US: adjustable sets that select or lock their weight, a fixed-weight dumbbell as the comparison, and strength exercises with household items as the route that costs nothing. Barbells, benches and racks are not scored here, and cardio machines are a separate decision in this catalogue. The safety score reads recalls in the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) recall database through its public interface, searched on 29 September 2026 by brand name in the recall title, product name and recall description. It counts recalls of dumbbells under the brand. A brand with no dumbbell recall scores 90, a recall older than five years scores 75, a recall inside five years with no injuries reported scores 55, one with injuries reported scores 35, and a recall that reports a death scores 10. A recall covers the models in the notice, and the notes say when the model sold now is a different one. CPSC lists only products with a reported hazard and a recall, so a score of 90 shows no recall was found and does not show a product is free of faults. The price score is the price of a pair divided by the heaviest weight one dumbbell reaches, taken from the seller's page on the day read, using the sale price where one is shown. It falls in a straight line from 100 at $1 a pound to 0 at $12 a pound. Sets whose pages give conflicting weights, or no price, are left unscored on price. The warranty score reads the terms printed on the seller's page. A lifetime warranty scores 100, a 5 year limited warranty 75, a 2 year parts warranty 45, a one year return guarantee 25 and a 30 day warranty 8. A page that gives no terms is left unscored. Not medical advice. A doctor or physiotherapist can advise on which weights suit a person, and CPSC's notices give the models involved. Reviewed 2026-09. Suggest changes via Contribute.

CPSC recall record for dumbbells under the brand
Warranty length printed on the seller's page

products.name: Bowflex Results Series 552 SelectTech dumbbells

economical.note: bowflex.com lists the Results Series 552 SelectTech Dumbbells at a regular price of $479 and a sale price of $399 marked as $80 off plus free shipping. A pair reaches 52.5 lb per dumbbell, so the sale price is about $7.60 for each pound of one dumbbell's top weight.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists a 5 June 2025 recall of BowFlex 552 and 1090 adjustable dumbbells (about 3,844,200 units, sold as early as 2004 through May 2025). Nautilus received 337 reports of plates dislodging during use, including 111 injuries such as concussions, abrasions, broken toes and contusions, and Johnson Health Tech Trading received 12 reports with no injuries for units it sold. It also lists a 2012 recall of SelectTech 1090 dumbbells for a failing weight selector dial (16 reports, 3 injuries). The 2025 recall is inside five years with injuries reported, so the score is 35.

durability.note: The bowflex.com page lists the standard warranty as 2 Years for parts, with protection plans sold to extend it to 3 or 5 years, and a 30 day return for a full product refund minus shipping. A 2 year parts warranty scores 45.

products.description: The market-leading dial-selected dumbbell, the subject of the largest recall on this roster. The page lists a Results Series 552 and shows no recall notice, and the CPSC notice covers BowFlex 552 units sold through May 2025.

products.name: NordicTrack 50 lb iSelect adjustable dumbbells

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists a 1 February 2024 recall of NordicTrack 50 LB iSelect Voice-Controlled Adjustable Dumbbells by iFIT (about 15,400 units), with 40 reports of weight plates dislodging during use and 8 injuries such as contusions and abrasions. It is inside five years with injuries reported, so the score is 35.

products.description: A voice-controlled adjustable dumbbell recalled in 2024 after 8 injuries. No price page could be read for it.

products.name: ProForm Rapid Strike 50 lb adjustable dumbbells

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists a 25 July 2024 recall of ProForm Rapid Strike 50 LB Adjustable Dumbbell Sets by iFIT (about 54,400 units), with 8 reports of weight plates dislodging during use and 3 injuries including contusions and abrasions. It is inside five years with injuries reported, so the score is 35.

products.description: A 50 lb adjustable set recalled in 2024. ProForm's site returned a rate limit error, so no price is scored.

products.name: FitRx SmartBell quick-select adjustable dumbbells

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists two recalls of FitRx SmartBell dumbbells by Tzumi Electronics: 20 March 2025 for the SmartBell XL 10 to 90 lb (about 12,400 units sold at Walmart.com, 60 reports, at least 7 injuries) and 23 April 2026 for the SmartBell 5 to 52.5 lb (about 50,000 units, more than 115 reports of plates dislodging, at least 6 injuries including broken toes and lacerations). Both are inside five years with injuries reported, so the score is 35.

products.description: A budget quick-select dumbbell with two recalls in 13 months. No price page could be read for it.

products.name: Amazon Basics 55 lb adjustable dumbbells

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists a 14 May 2026 recall of Amazon Basics 55 Lbs. Adjustable Dumbbells (about 2,900 units) after 8 reports of weight plates not engaging completely during adjustment and dislodging during use, with no injuries reported. It is inside five years with no injuries reported, so the score is 55.

products.description: Amazon's own adjustable set, recalled in May 2026 with no injuries reported. Amazon's site refused automated requests, so no price is scored.

products.name: PowerBlock Pro 50 adjustable dumbbells

economical.note: powerblock.com lists the Pro 50 Adjustable Dumbbells at a regular price of $549, adjusting from 5 to 50 lb per dumbbell, so the price is about $10.98 for each pound of one dumbbell's top weight.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists a 24 October 2024 recall of the PowerBlock Commercial Pro 100 set sold with 5 lb grip handles (about 1,845 units), after four reports of weight plates slipping beyond the handle during use and no injuries. The Pro 50 is a different model. It is inside five years with no injuries reported, so the score is 55.

durability.note: The powerblock.com page for the Pro 50 states a 5 year limited warranty for residential use only, and describes it as not valid for commercial use. A 5 year limited warranty scores 75.

products.description: A pin-selected set at the top of the price range, with a 5 year warranty and one 2024 recall of a different, commercial set.

products.name: Ironmaster Quick-Lock 75 lb adjustable dumbbells

economical.note: ironmaster.com lists the Quick-Lock Adjustable Dumbbell System 75 lb Set, a pair adjusting from 5 to 75 lb per dumbbell, at $699, which is about $9.32 for each pound of one dumbbell's top weight.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database, searched on 29 September 2026 for Ironmaster in the recall description, returned an empty list. Searches of the recall title and product name fields gave the same result.

durability.note: The ironmaster.com page states that its adjustable dumbbells are guaranteed for life with a no-frills lifetime warranty. That scores 100.

products.description: A heavy set with a lifetime warranty and no CPSC recall found, at a high price.

products.name: LifePro adjustable dumbbells, 25 lb pair

economical.note: Target lists the LifePro Adjustable Dumbbells Set, 25 lb pair adjusting from 5 to 25 lb, at $189.99, sold and shipped by LifePro, with a 30 day return for a full refund. That is about $7.60 for each pound of one dumbbell's top weight. The page states no warranty, so no durability score is given.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database lists two records for Lifepro, a 2025 recall of infrared sauna blankets and a 2015 recall of mini space heaters made by another firm under the Lifepro name. It lists no dumbbell recall, so the dumbbells score 90.

products.description: A light pin-adjusted set sold by its maker on Target, with no dumbbell recall found.

products.name: All In Motion adjustable dumbbell, 25 lb

economical.note: Target lists the All In Motion Adjustable Dumbbell 25 lbs, a single steel and plastic dumbbell adjusting from 5 to 25 lb, at $100, sold by Target. A pair costs $200, which is about $8.00 for each pound of one dumbbell's top weight.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database, searched on 29 September 2026 for All In Motion in the recall description, returned an empty list. Searches of the recall title and product name fields gave the same result.

durability.note: The Target page says that any Target Owned Brand item can be returned within one year with a receipt for an exchange or a refund. That is a return guarantee and not a repair warranty, and it scores 25.

products.description: Target's own adjustable dumbbell, sold singly, with a one year return guarantee and no CPSC recall found.

products.name: Flybird 5 in 1 adjustable dumbbell set

safety.note: CPSC's recall database, searched on 29 September 2026 for Flybird in the recall description, returned an empty list. Searches of the recall title and product name fields gave the same result.

products.description: A budget set sold on Target by FEIER FITNESS INC, with no CPSC recall found. Its Target page gives conflicting weight figures and no warranty, so no price or warranty is scored.

products.name: Yes4All adjustable dumbbell set, 40 lb

economical.note: Target lists the Yes4All Adjustable Dumbbell Set with Weight Plates, Collars and Connector, 40 lb, at $53, sold and shipped by Spreetail, with free 30 day returns. The set has two handles, four 5 lb plates and four 3 lb plates, so each dumbbell reaches about 20 lb and the price is about $2.65 for each pound of one dumbbell's top weight. The page states no warranty, so no durability score is given.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database, searched on 29 September 2026 for Yes4All in the recall description, returned an empty list. Searches of the recall title and product name fields gave the same result.

products.description: The cheapest adjustable set on the roster per pound, using plates and collars that are changed by hand, with no CPSC recall found.

products.name: Yaheetech 66 lb adjustable dumbbell set

safety.note: CPSC's recall database, searched on 29 September 2026 for Yaheetech in the recall description, returned an empty list. Searches of the recall title and product name fields gave the same result.

products.description: A budget plate-and-collar set listed at $69.99 on Target, with no CPSC recall found. Its page states the maximum weight in a way that could be read per dumbbell or per set, and states no warranty, so no price per pound or warranty is scored.

products.name: CAP coated hex dumbbell, 12 lb (fixed weight)

economical.note: Target lists the CAP 12lbs Coated Hex Dumbbell with Contoured Handle at $15.99 for the 12 lb size. A pair of 12 lb dumbbells costs $31.98, which is about $2.67 for each pound of one dumbbell's weight.

safety.note: CPSC's recall database, searched on 29 September 2026 for CAP Barbell in the recall description, returned an empty list. Searches of the recall title and product name fields gave the same result.

durability.note: The Target page says the dumbbell includes a 30 day manufacturer's warranty, which scores 8.

products.description: A fixed-weight dumbbell with no selector to fail, which is the comparison for every adjustable set here, sold singly and bought one weight at a time.

products.name: Strength exercises at home with household items

economical.note: The NHS says strength exercises like these can be done at home to improve health and mobility, and its dumbbell exercise instructions say to hold a pair of light weights and that filled water bottles will do.

products.description: The route that needs no equipment purchase. It has no CPSC record because it is not a product.
